subject: English
question_text: Change the narrative style of the following text.
stimulus: "Good morning, students," said the teacher. "How are you?" "We are fine, sir. What about you?" "I am fine too. Please, sit down." "Have you prepared your lesson?" the teacher asked. "Sorry, sir, we have not prepared our lesson," they replied.
guide_solution: Jaman asked Mrs Rahman what kind of stories Aesop had told. Mrs Rahman replied that he (A) had told fables. She asked Jaman if he (J) knew what fables are. Jaman replied in the negative. At this, Mrs Rahman continued that fables are stories with a message or a moral.
